provenance.purpose: Raw service-occurrence recovery regression; these are original served packets, not future candidate outputs.
provenance.normalization: Only Pink #326 is retained. Row and repeat-visit bus indices are remapped to0. Selected original rows/distributions/clocks/rawhop values, descriptors/travel and full bus objects are retained. Stop coordinates are limited to the canonical Pink route. No service-count metadata or candidate forecasts are invented.
